answer: A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, because each one must be independent on the tundra graph and each exposes its bond to the kernel slash if it rubber-stamps. Since disagreement burns everyone the epoch, the nectar audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. A verdict only settles when 3 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. That is 16 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
